context:
Sequencing matters more than scope. Phase 0 starts with zero-risk dead
removals (sphinx pair, lxml) to build review confidence before touching
`[project] dependencies` (jsonschema, chdb-core), which affect every
install. Phase 2 then makes the jsonschema move structural rather than
cosmetic. Phase 4 prevents regression. Phase 3 waits for a real release
boundary.
description:
Umbrella TODO that sequences the dependency-tightening work emerging from
the `audit-imported-dependencies-for-elimination` audit
(`docs/development/dependency-inventory.md`).

The audit flagged 6 of 76 packages (~8%) for elimination/relocation. Most
of the realistic ceiling for tightening is unlocked not by individual
flags, but by structural changes:

  - Moving internal tooling (`_project/scripts/`) out of the shipped
    manifest entirely (Phase 2).
  - Adding a CI guard so the audit doesn't decay (Phase 4).

This parent TODO tracks all five phases. Phases 0 and 1 are already
enumerated as standalone child TODOs (linked below). Phases 2 and 4
are tracked as new child TODOs created alongside this parent. Phase 3
is a deferred v0.3.0 milestone (breaking changes); recorded here for
traceability rather than as an immediate child TODO.

Realistic outcome after all five phases:
  - Core deps drop from 14 → 12 (−14%)
  - Dev dep group drops by ≥3 packages
  - Extras count drops ~10 (Phase 3, v0.3.0)
  - Future regressions caught by CI

anti_patterns.dont: bundle multiple phases into one PR
anti_patterns.why: reviewer surface and rollback granularity both suffer

anti_patterns.dont: chase the remaining 70 KEEP entries looking for hidden fat
anti_patterns.instead: focus structural effort on Phase 2 and Phase 4
anti_patterns.why: the audit already verified each has a real owner

anti_patterns.dont: execute Phase 3 outside a v0.3.0 milestone
anti_patterns.why: plain-name extras may be pinned in user installs in the wild

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import pathlib; planned = {p.stem for p in pathlib.Path('_project/TODO/main/planning').glob('*.yaml')}; done = {p.stem for p in pathlib.Path('_project/DONE/main/active').glob('*.yaml')}; required = {'clean-up-unused-sphinx-dev-deps', 'drop-lxml-dev-dep-or-port-test-to-stdlib', 'move-jsonschema-out-of-core-runtime-deps', 'drop-chdb-core-from-core-dependencies', 'declare-undeclared-runtime-imports'}; missing = required - (planned | done); assert not missing, 'Missing Phase 0 children: ' + str(missing); print('OK: all Phase 0 children present')"
verifications.description: All Phase 0 child TODOs exist in planning/ or completed in DONE/

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import pathlib; planned = {p.stem for p in pathlib.Path('_project/TODO/main/planning').glob('*.yaml')}; done = {p.stem for p in pathlib.Path('_project/DONE/main/active').glob('*.yaml')}; required = {'extract-project-scripts-to-isolated-env', 'add-dependency-audit-ci-guard'}; missing = required - (planned | done); assert not missing, 'Missing children: ' + str(missing); print('OK: Phase 2+4 children present')"

work_units.summary: Phase 0 - execute the 5 ready follow-ups in order: sphinx-dev-deps → lxml → jsonschema → chdb-core → declare-undeclared. One PR each.
Phase 1 - fold into Phase 0's `declare-undeclared-runtime-imports` TODO (covers `pillow`, `ansi2html`, AI-primitives extras). No separate child TODO needed.
Phase 2 - execute child TODO `extract-project-scripts-to-isolated-env` to give internal TODO/release tooling its own pyproject.toml so jsonschema/ruamel-yaml leave the main manifest entirely.
Phase 4 - execute child TODO `add-dependency-audit-ci-guard` to promote the audit's AST scripts into a `make audit-deps` check wired into CI.
